initial_prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit/recompose the supplied project-owned character comparison into a single polished in-game environmental concept of an ORC CAMP, preserving the approved olive-skinned orc appearance, red-brown leather clothes, metal shoulder armor and axe. Keep the same hand-painted stylized fantasy RPG materials and fixed isometric game camera (orthographic, looking down about 45 degrees). The supplied hero is a scale reference and may stand at the entrance. Remove the comparison-sheet backdrop and typography. Show one complete compact camp embedded naturally in a grassy conifer clearing: irregular worn dirt paths, a sturdy patched hide shelter, rough timber lean-to, a broken low palisade only along one side, firepit, chopped logs, barrels and supply crates with believable use; dense wild trees/rocks on its outer edge. Center is an open traversable fight space, clearly connected to a wide unobstructed entrance, with several approved orcs separated so hero silhouettes and weapons read. Keep props around edges, no maze, no full enclosure or new enemy type. Deliberate asymmetry and practical living spaces, layered ground wear and organic clumps instead of a regular grid or scattered lonely props. Lighting and grassy ground match current project, crisp readable painterly fantasy not photorealistic, not dark horror. No UI, no labels, no text, no loot beams, no quest icon. Landscape concept art, entire encounter silhouette and surrounding transition into the world visible, not an asset sheet. This is a visual proposal only, no implied enemy counts or new mechanics.

Use case: stylized-concept. Edit/recompose the supplied project-owned character comparison into a single polished in-game environmental concept of an OGRE CAMP, preserving the approved huge matte PURPLE ogre appearance, leather harness, brown wraps and heavy wooden club; use the supplied hero only as a small scale reference at the safe approach. Same hand-painted stylized fantasy RPG, fixed orthographic isometric game camera looking down about45degrees. Remove comparison backdrop and all text. Clearly different from an orc timber camp: a long-abandoned stone ruin beside a rocky wooded clearing, collapsed low mossy masonry, one weathered broken arch at the far perimeter, enormous rough sleeping hides beneath a broad stone overhang, oversized piled logs and a heavy crude firepit, ordinary broken barrels and crates near the side. Ogres have appropriated the ruin rather than built a village. Strong readable silhouette, a broad open fight clearing with multiple walkable approaches, realistic wide spacing for ogres; all high scenery is on far/side perimeter and never hides the hero. Several of the approved purple ogres, no orcs, no new monsters, no boss/magic altar, no buildings with services. Natural dirt scuffs, lichen, scrub and irregular rocks blend encounter into grassy conifer world. Sparse monumental stone forms contrast the orc camp's dense timber/hide details. Crisp readable painterly style matching project, not photorealism. No UI, text, labels, loot beams, quest icons. Landscape complete encounter concept, not sprite sheet. Visual proposal only, no implied population, loot or combat balance.

owner_feedback: v1 rejected as enclosed trap; v2 broad open maneuvering field with scenery to side, stationary-only bow. Awaiting owner appearance approval.
